lines.x: Kenyan telecommunications firm Safaricom reported a 35.9% increase in net profit to Sh58.2 billion for the six months ending September.
The World Bank reported that corruption in Kenya results in billions of dollars in lost revenue and inflated business costs, significantly impeding investment and overall economic growth.
ActionAid reports that climate-vulnerable African countries are diverting substantial public funds toward foreign debt repayments instead of climate resilience and food security projects.
South Africa's Nedbank Group completed its acquisition of a 66 percent stake in NCBA Group, bringing the Kenyan lender under its control in a cash deal worth Sh23.23 billion.
